argv: d() { if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$1" | sha256sum; else printf '%s' "$1" | shasum -a 256; fi; }; printf '\033]2;vt:%.64s screen:%.64s\007' "$(d "$1")" "$(d "$2")"

steps.note: a second terminal titles itself vt:<sha256 of the VT state> screen:<sha256 of the screen text>; it starts in / because a new terminal otherwise inherits the folder the stream's OSC 7 reported, which does not exist
the settled checkpoint holds the hash terminal's title: the arms and the baseline compare it
